sources.entry: Arq - Cloud storage backup client that supports AWS, GCP, DropBox, and more.

summary.name: Arq
summary.one_liner: Arq is paid backup software for macOS and Windows that encrypts and versions backups to cloud accounts, SFTP servers, external drives, or NAS devices.
use_cases: encrypted off-site backup of a Mac or Windows PC
recovering earlier versions of corrupted or deleted files
backing up to an existing cloud storage account
protecting files from ransomware with point-in-time restore
backing up to a NAS, SFTP server, or external drive
scheduled backups that pause on battery or specific Wi-Fi networks
summary.what_it_does: Arq backs up files on macOS and Windows to a cloud account the user already has, an attached disk, an SFTP server, or a NAS, and can send to multiple destinations at once. It encrypts data end-to-end and uses filesystem snapshots to take point-in-time backups even while files change. It keeps a backup history so older versions can be restored, and restores can be done from within the app. Scheduling and limits are configurable, including hourly or daily backups, bandwidth limits, battery and Wi-Fi exclusions, retention limits, and custom exclusion rules.
notable: Encrypted backups stored in an open, documented format
Uses native APFS snapshot support for consistent backups
Arq Premium bundles up to 5 computers with managed cloud storage
caveats: Offers a 30-day free trial; a license is needed after that
Annual update subscription of $25 USD per computer after the first year of updates
Arq Premium storage beyond 1TB billed at $.0059/GB per month
